title: Integral Koszul braiding commutes with the prescribed scalar-extension tensor comparison
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E\subset L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside a fixed algebraic closure, with valuation rings $\mathcal O_E\subset\mathcal O_L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $W$ on which $\ell$ is invertible in every residue field. Let $D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$ and $D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_L)$ be the derived-complete bounded constructible integral categories [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], with completed derived tensors $T^{\mathrm{int}}_{E}$ and $T^{\mathrm{int}}_{L}$ and coherently reduction-normalized integral Koszul braidings $\beta^{E}_{M,N}:T^{\mathrm{int}}_E(M,N)\xrightarrow{\sim}T^{\mathrm{int}}_E(N,M)$ and $\beta^{L}$ of [def-pod-integral-tensor-constraints]. Let $K\mapsto K_L=K\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L$ be the integral scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], and let $\lambda^{\mathrm{int}}_{M,N}:(T^{\mathrm{int}}_E(M,N))_L\xrightarrow{\sim}T^{\mathrm{int}}_L(M_L,N_L)$ be the prescribed tensor scalar comparison of [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension]. Then for all $M,N\in D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$,
$$\lambda^{\mathrm{int}}_{N,M}\circ(\beta^{E}_{M,N})_L=\beta^{L}_{M_L,N_L}\circ\lambda^{\mathrm{int}}_{M,N}.$$
This holds for every finite extension $E\subset L$, including $L=E$ and ramified extensions; no finite-field structure on $W$, perfectness or torsion-freeness hypothesis is added.
